title: Mass Oral Cholera Vaccination in Zanzibar
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to conduct cholera vaccinations in high-risk populations in Zanzibar in order to estimate herd protection conferred by the vaccine,estimate effectiveness of the vaccine, and describe the interaction of vaccination and improved water supply on the burden of cholera and diarrhoeal diseases.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy residents of selected vaccination sites
* Aged 2 years and older
* non-pregnant

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age less than 2 years
* Pregnant
